SELECT DISTINCT kp2.id, kp2.course_id AS courseId, kp2.chapter_id AS chapterId, kp2.name, kp2.sort_order AS sortOrder, kp2.description, kp2.created_at AS createdAt, kp2.updated_at AS updatedAt, kp2.created_by AS createdBy FROM knowledge_points kp1 JOIN knowledge_point_relations r ON (r.from_point_id = kp1.id OR r.to_point_id = kp1.id) AND r.relation_type = 'CONFUSABLE' AND r.status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN knowledge_points kp2 ON kp2.id = IF(r.from_point_id = kp1.id, r.to_point_id, r.from_point_id) WHERE kp1.course_id = #{courseId}
